name: MathlibAnnex.FiniteSup.FinMapAlmostIsometric
title: A strict lower bound on a norm's unit sphere

content.display_title: A strict lower bound on a norm's unit sphere
content.one_sentence_role: Defines the strict lower condition on a fixed norm unit sphere.
content.natural_language_statement:
Let $n,N\in\mathbb N$ be arbitrary, including zero. Use reference coordinates $V=\mathbb R^n$ with the sup norm and standard basis. The supplied continuous seminorm $p$ has constants $a_p,b_p>0$ satisfying
$$a_p\|x\|_\infty\le p(x)\le b_p\|x\|_\infty\quad(x\in V).$$
Thus $p$ is a norm; it can differ from the reference sup norm. Fix any $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$ and continuous real linear $A:V\to\mathbb R^N$, with the target sup norm. Define the property by
$$\forall x\in V,\quad p(x)=1\ \Longrightarrow\ 1-\varepsilon<\|Ax\|_\infty.$$
content.definition_explanation: The property requires the displayed strict lower bound at every $p$-unit vector. It is a condition on the given map $A$, not a construction of a new map.
content.assumptions: The inputs are the continuous seminorm $p$ with its positive two-sided comparison bounds, any real $\varepsilon$, and the fixed continuous real linear map $A$. Neither an upper estimate on $A$, positivity of $\varepsilon$, nor injectivity of $A$ is an input to this definition.
content.conclusion: This is only the lower unit-sphere condition. In dimension zero the unit sphere is empty and the condition is vacuous.
content.lean_realization_notes:
As a separate consequence, let $x\ne0$. Positive definiteness gives $p(x)>0$, and
$$p(x/p(x))=1,\qquad \|A(x/p(x))\|_\infty=\|Ax\|_\infty/p(x).$$
Apply the condition at that same vector and multiply by $p(x)>0$ to obtain
$$(1-\varepsilon)p(x)<\|Ax\|_\infty.$$
This is [the lower bound away from zero](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/Normed/Operator/FiniteSup.lean#L575-L598). It adds no upper estimate.
